title: Tessra Request Panel — redesign world
question: 현재 UI는 anti-reference입니다. critique의 P0–P2를 한 시각 체계로 푸는 redesign 방향을 고르세요. 기능·데이터·메시지 계약은 변하지 않습니다.

options.label: REPL Command Strip
options.lineage: Terminal multiplexer / developer REPL prompt line
options.thesis: 요청 작성은 한 줄의 명령이고, 응답 Body는 스크롤백이다.
options.viewport: Top: thin status strip (env · profile · defaults as text, expand on click). Hero: Method | URL | Send as one command row. Below: request tabs as simple underlines. Split: response Body owns the canvas; status/time/size as one sticky line. Meta (variables, compare, mode) behind › expand or overflow.
options.case: Audience + clarity both win: API workers already think in prompt→output. Method→URL→Send→Body is the only loud band.
options.risk: 메타를 너무 숨기면 환경 전환 발견성이 떨어질 수 있음 — status strip은 항상 1줄은 남긴다.
options.body: VS Code 토큰 밀도. pill/card/shadow/bounce 금지. 성공 green은 응답 sticky 한곳. DEFAULT HEADERS는 HEADERS 안 nested card가 아니라 status strip의 Defaults › 또는 Headers 탭 한 줄 summary.

options.label: Teletext Reveal Grid
options.lineage: Broadcast teletext magazine · fused for Operate
options.thesis: 메타는 숨김 페이지이고, REVEAL로만 펼친다. Body 격자가 항상 보인다.
options.viewport: Rigid dense rows: METHOD URL [SEND]. Response Body fills a character-grid-like code pane. Status digits in a header corner. Env/defaults/compare sit as held 'pages' behind REVEAL — one click peels them open as block rows, never as pills.
options.case: Clarity: progressive disclosure is literal. Audience: retro signal may feel gimmicky inside VS Code unless teletext color is translated to VS Code tokens (yellow=headline, cyan=live figures, red=alert only).
options.risk: 원색 teletext를 그대로 쓰면 VS Code native가 깨짐 — 문법은 유지하고 팔레트는 토큰으로 번역해야 함.
options.body: Fuse: teletext supplies REVEAL topology + rigid density; Tessra supplies API facts. No mosaic decoration for its own sake.

options.label: Concourse Decision Bands
options.lineage: Airport terminal wayfinding · fused for Operate
options.thesis: 매 시점 하나의 결정 밴드만 크게: 지금은 Send, 그다음은 Body.
options.viewport: A single primary band: GET · {{baseUrl}}/sitemap.xml · SEND. Secondary band (smaller): Env · Defaults · Profile as wayfinding text, not chips. After send, the monumental number becomes 200 and the Body pane is the concourse ahead. Compare lives at a junction overflow, not on the main band.
options.case: Clarity excellent for hierarchy. Audience: strong for task focus; yellow band must stay restrained (one band accent) or it becomes dashboard again.
options.risk: Schiphol yellow를 넓게 쓰면 critique가 금지한 장식 경쟁으로 회귀.
options.body: Fuse: wayfinding supplies one-decision-per-band + progressive junctions; Tessra keeps method colors as small pictogram squares, not pill clusters.

canonCard.label: VS Code API client, played straight
canonCard.lineage: Thunder Client / Insomnia / Bruno craft level — category standard
canonCard.thesis: 익숙한 API 클라이언트 문법을 VS Code 토큰으로 정직하게 실행한다.
canonCard.viewport: Method · URL · Send toolbar. Tabs underline. Response Body dominant after send. Meta in a quiet status bar. No nested cards, no pill walls.
canonCard.case: Safer path if Tessra should sit next to Thunder Client without a distinctive world.
canonCard.risk: 정체성 신호가 약해질 수 있음 — method color + local-first cues만으로 차별화.
canonCard.body: Standing exit. Not recommended by the roll; available if you want the familiar competitor craft bar.
